findings.title: 无性别配对的绝对拒绝句与 Ditto 例外产生内部冲突
findings.reviewer: M06 independent reviewer; requested gpt-6-astra/ultra/default; actual parameters UNVERIFIED

source_anchors.caller_config: get_compatibility and256-step cycle; no plugin needed
source_anchors.supported_fact: After two-slot/Shadow/Undiscovered/egg-group gates, exactly one Ditto-group parent passes gender compatibility irrespective of whether both actual genders are genderless; score1 plus same-species and different-owner-ID bonuses.

source_anchors.caller_config: Default top-level PBS; ordinary non-Shadow/non-egg members
source_anchors.supported_fact: Default distinct species are both genderless, neither in Undiscovered; no authored data change required.

source_anchors.caller_config: Species gender_ratio through current stored form
source_anchors.supported_fact: Genderless species return gender2; cannot satisfy female/male first branches; Ditto exception is decisive.

spec_anchors.current_statement: One Ditto-group plus non-Ditto allows any gender/genderless, followed by unqualified parenthetical “无性别 + 无性别不兼容”.
Same positive exception and absolute genderless refusal preserved in original.
DC-08(a) permits DITTO plus a breedable non-Ditto after earlier gates; DC-07 qualifies same-gender refusal with non-Ditto. This is counterevidence to a missing-feature claim.

expected_reference_behavior.premises: 默认形态0普通非蛋非Shadow亲本，两个槽占用、有效owner.id，无插件/自定义性别缓存/数据替换。
expected_reference_behavior.compatibility: 先检查两槽、Shadow、Undiscovered及共同蛋组/Ditto资格；性别条件为正常雌雄对或恰一方Ditto组。合格后等级=1+同物种指示值+不同拥有者ID指示值。DITTO/MAGNEMITE同ID为1、异ID为2，两槽序一致。
expected_reference_behavior.cycle: 概率只针对无已有蛋且两个占用槽到达256通知周期的检定：等级1为20%/40%，等级2为50%/80%（无/有背包圆形护符）。达到阈值先清周期计数；命中仅置标记，不生成实体。已有蛋时跳过该抽样，不许泛称每个256物理步必生蛋。
expected_reference_behavior.boundary: 默认DITTO/DITTO、MAGNEMITE/MAGNEMITE、DITTO/PICHU均0；Shadow及单槽各先行0。直接生成/领取保留独立守卫；普通接待可达性仍未知。

findings.current_spec_behavior: The explicit positive branch and DC-08(a) support that result, but the unqualified parenthetical can be read as an additional absolute rejection of the same input. The candidate alleges an internal conflict, not absence of the Ditto capability.
findings.gap: 末尾双无性别括注单看过宽，但同句明确单Ditto的任意性别例外与DC-07/08足以承接，未证明现行可实施行为缺口。
preconditions: No custom gender overrides or plugins

minimal_counterexample.conflicting_literal_result: 0 if the parenthetical is treated as absolute

findings.normal_case: Male and female compatible non-Ditto species use normal gender branch; default DITTO plus eligible gendered non-Ditto uses the exception.
findings.failure_or_boundary_case: DITTO+DITTO remains0; MAGNEMITE+MAGNEMITE remains0; DITTO+PICHU is0 due to earlier Undiscovered gate. Direct generate/collect retains its different guard and is not changed.
findings.impact_on_independent_implementation: 按同一条款明确的单Ditto例外和相邻测试即可实现源结果；缺少具名MAGNEMITE案例不构成必修。

negative_evidence_search.completed_scope: Full current assigned WP30–38 bodies/context and all assigned vectors; full original WP33/WP34 comparisons. Relevant current shared gender/data clauses directly read. Repository-wide current formal synonym search used as navigation, not proof by no-hit.

reads.result: Earlier OR rule,§5.1 step4/step6 and§122 are positive counterevidence; no explicit scope attached to the final genderless parenthesis.
§9 genderless non-Ditto+Ditto role exists; generation bypasses compatibility, so this alone does not repair the compatibility sentence.
DC-08(a) allows qualified breedable non-Ditto, consistent with source; no named genderless pair to arbitrate parenthesis.
BR26 adds Undiscovered contrast; not this genderless boundary.
Original preserves same wording; not a sanitation-only loss.

negative_evidence_search.independent_counterevidence: pending; explicit earlier OR and DC08(a) may justify no_required_revision, so no final mandatory verdict is signed

findings.proposed_spec_change: 无必修改动；可选澄清末尾括注，保持原Ditto/Shadow/Undiscovered及直接领取边界。

acceptance_criteria.preserve: 原源核验、先行拒绝、概率条件、两槽序与直接工具分层均作为本次静态证明保留。
acceptance_criteria.optional_only: 若维护者愿意，仅为末尾双无性别括注补不满足前述单Ditto例外的限定，可加DITTO/MAGNEMITE具名正向对照；这不增加能力、不替换旧PICHU/Shadow反例，也不阻塞当前规格使用。

dependencies: WP34 direct generation versus compatibility separation

history_links.relation: new_wording_scope_reviewed_under_original_GR5_ID; no old issue reopened; no new consumer defect confirmed

old_ditto_gate.scope: 旧项为DC-08过宽允许绕过Shadow/Undiscovered先行门；两者合并的旧P3范围保持。当前DC-08与BR26及R的DITTO/PICHU=0已直读核实。本轮的无性别括注问题不与之合并计数、不重开。

third_round.scope: 同级经验增减提示先于经验写入；不同根因，仅保留原接受范围，不扩为育种资格PASS。

fourth_round.scope: 双不同Power不能同时有Knot的BR18输入前提与局部IV向量；现行BR18/R4-IV已读。四项接受标准和任何历史隔离执行仅保原输入/范围，不作为本次执行、不重开旧接受。

unknowns: 真实寄养接待事件的选项、收费/守卫及画面无材料或运行证明；不影响静态资格裁决。
第三方插件/自定义Ditto蛋组或手改缓存不在本候选前提；未推演为新增框架输入承诺。
模型、reasoning_effort、service_tier与Fast实际参数回显不可得，均UNVERIFIED。
excluded_claims: 排除当前规格缺少无性别与Ditto繁殖能力的说法。
排除把负向括注作为新增最终覆盖门、却仍称满足完整正文与测试的解释。
排除无具名MAGNEMITE向量即必须修订或按文件重复计缺口。
排除仅凭WP34成功生成来证明WP33兼容性；本裁决用WP33本身及DC测试反证。
排除所有Ditto输入都兼容、自定义异性双Ditto组必修及任何公开低层API架构扩展。
排除周期概率不带无已有蛋/周期到达前提；排除实际随机结果、游戏接待/画面或宿主已运行的断言。

basis.challenge: 提出者把末尾无性别+无性别括注读为覆盖前述单Ditto例外的绝对拒绝。该孤立字面读法确实会给默认DITTO/MAGNEMITE算0；需证明它是完整合同可接受的行为，才能升为必修。
basis.independent_source_result: 直接从默认PBS、性别读取、完整兼容谓词和调用/周期推导，两槽序同ID均1、异ID均2。未按提出者摘要或历史PASS替代阅读。
decisive_counterevidence: WP33§5.1同一项先明确任一项成立即兼容，并在单Ditto分支明确任意性别/无性别。这不是需要靠外部官方知识补入的例外。
相邻122行要求仅先通过占用/Shadow/Undiscovered门的非Ditto再算关系等级，没有增加双无性别否决。
DC-07把同性别拒绝限定为非Ditto；DC-08(a)保留合格单Ditto，(b/c/d)保留双Ditto、Undiscovered、Shadow拒绝；原稿兼容行同样如此。
WP34无性别非Ditto生成角色只作相邻一致性对照：因直接生成不校验兼容，不能以该生成表单独补救资格规则。
basis.why_no_required_revision: 完整局部条款可一致理解为一般双无性别不兼容、明确的单Ditto例外优先。若实现无条件拒绝DITTO/MAGNEMITE，会直接违反同句明确的正向允许及限定测试；这不是文档同时明确接受的第二个结果。括注可改得更清楚，但本轮未证仍存在一个行为事实缺口，不能仅以误读风险维持P2或降作P3必修。
basis.remaining_editorial_issue: 末尾括注孤立看缺少非Ditto限定，这一文字事实保留。可自愿改成不满足前述单Ditto例外的双无性别配对不兼容，或加具名MAGNEMITE例；不作为正式验收阻塞。
basis.scope_limits: 只审原候选的默认普通输入与现有承诺；不扩到自定义可雌雄Ditto蛋组、原始字段篡改、插件覆写或所有公开低层入口。非蛋是本夹具前提，不冒充源兼容函数的独立拒蛋门。
